quarterly_data.signal: Fabrinet's 10-Q states that in February 2025 it began construction of a new manufacturing facility of approximately 2.0 million square feet at its Chonburi campus, with a total expected project cost of approximately $132.5 million (Thai baht 4.45 billion).
quarterly_data.figure: Chonburi ~2.0 million sq ft facility: expected project cost ~$132.5 million (Thai baht 4.45 billion)

connects_to.relationship: high-performance computing (HPC) program manufacturing for AWS custom silicon platforms

contracts.signal: Fabrinet's 10-Q states that on March 12, 2025 it issued Amazon.com NV Investment Holdings LLC a warrant to acquire Fabrinet ordinary shares. Apart from the portion that vested at issuance, the warrant shares vest in multiple tranches over the term of the warrant based on payments to Fabrinet from or on behalf of Amazon.com, Inc. or its affiliates under a commercial agreement or otherwise.
contracts.type: customer warrant vesting on payments under a commercial agreement (10-Q disclosure)
